The '''Silestro Privateers''' was a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] operating in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Their leader was [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jostero]] and their headquarters were in the [[Rayless Lantern]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Pirate's Shadow]] belt.
